sources.title: Stability challenges
sources.content: Moisture and heat degrade perovskite layers, and stability remains the main barrier to commercialization.

report:
## Executive Summary
Perovskite solar cells have reached efficiencies above 26 percent [1]. However, stability under moisture and heat remains the main barrier to commercialization [2].

## Key Findings
- Perovskite-silicon tandem cells exceed 33 percent efficiency in the laboratory [3].
- Several startups aim to ship modules commercially within a few years [4].
- Adoption will be widespread by next year in every country.

## Limitations
The sources did not cover long-term field reliability data.
